fields.title: Correlation type
fields.description:
Choose the type of correlation. The coefficient must be in the range from −1 (100% negative association,
or perfect inversion) to +1 (100% positive association, or perfect agreement). A value of zero indicates the
 absence of association.

fields.title: Correlation columns
fields.description: Select the columns for which correlation values should be computed.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Include only column pairs with a valid correlation
fields.description:
Check this option if only the column pairs where the correlation could be computed should be
included in the output table. Column pairs where the correlation could not be computed are
then omitted from the output table.

fields.title: p-value
fields.description: Select which p-value should be computed for Spearman's rank correlation coefficient.
